companies.title: Companies
companies.description: Companies to pull filings for, one per line. Accepts tickers ("AAPL", "MSFT"), CIK numbers ("320193" or "0000320193") or company names ("Tesla").

formTypes.title: Form types
formTypes.description: Only these form types, one per line ("10-K", "10-Q", "8-K", "S-1", "DEF 14A", "4"). Prefix-matched, so "10-K" also catches "10-K/A" amendments. Leave empty for all forms.

sinceDays.title: Filed within (days)
sinceDays.description: Only filings from the last N days. 0 = no date limit (goes back through the company's history as far as the row cap allows).

maxPerCompany.title: Filings per company
maxPerCompany.description: How many filings to return per company, newest first.

newOnly.title: Monitor mode: new filings only
newOnly.description: Remember filings already returned and emit only ones not seen before. Run on a schedule for a clean feed of new filings - quiet runs cost nothing.

maxRows.title: Max rows
maxRows.description: Stop after this many rows in total.
